notes.title: Updated to version 1.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for gamepad controls
[*] Improved the flow for unlocking optional levels
[*] Several minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Added clue display feature
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added clue display feature. It helps you get through difficult levels where you are stuck.
[*]Corrected some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Spanish and Korean languages added
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Spanish and Korean languages have been added.
[*] Corrected text in French and German.
[/list]

tags.feature: Spanish and Korean languages have been added.

tags.bug: Corrected text in French and German.

notes.title: Modified two levels and the grid behavior
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The solutions for level 11 have been reduced.
[*] Level 18 is now less difficult.
[*] The grid is now less likely to blend into the background grass.
[*] The grid now correctly follows window resizing.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: The solutions for level 11 have been reduced.

tags.bug: The grid is now less likely to blend into the background grass.
The grid now correctly follows window resizing.

notes.title: Added a V-sync option and reduced CPU load
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added  a V-sync option
[*]Fixed a problem where the CPU load could increase significantly depending on the environment
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a problem where the CPU load could increase significantly depending on the environment
